answer_1.quote: We introduce AFRIDOC-MT, a document-level translation dataset in the health and tech domains for five African languages. We benchmarked various models...
answer_1.outputs: translated documents and sentences in target languages

answer_2.quote: We evaluate performance using automatic metrics... then computed BLEU and chrF to create document BLEU (d-BLEU) and document chrF (d-chrF).

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-4o as a judge to evaluate translation outputs... we assess each translated document's fluency, content errors (CE), and cohesion errors-specifically lexical (LE) and grammatical (GE) errors-using GPT-4o

answer_4.quote: For the human evaluation, three native speakers of the African languages... were recruited. Each annotator was assigned 80 documents to evaluate, tasked with marking as many spans as possible and rating the overall quality on a scale from 0 to 100.
answer_4.guideline: rating the overall quality on a scale from 0 to 100 following error span annotation (ESA) protocol
